cards.ex: Oh, the train was delayed? That makes sense.
I'm struggling with this report. → But I'm making progress! (struggle with + 대상, make progress = 진전을 보이다)
This place is amazing! — I know, right?
I'm slightly nervous. → I spent the entire day on it. (slightly + 형용사, the entire + 명사)
I finally quit smoking. — Good for you!

quiz.q: So the meeting moved to Friday? Oh, that ___ .
quiz.note: That makes sense = 이해돼요. sense에 a·s 붙이지 않아요!

quiz.q: I'm really ___ with this report — it's taking forever.
quiz.note: be struggling with + 대상 = ~ 때문에 고생 중이다.

quiz.q: This coffee is so good! — I know, ___ ?
quiz.note: I know, right? = 그러니까! 동의하며 맞장구치는 원어민 리액션.

quiz.q: I'm ___ nervous about the interview tomorrow.
quiz.note: slightly(부사) + 형용사. a little의 세련된 버전!
Good for you! = 잘됐다! 상대의 성취를 축하하는 한마디.

cards.ex: If you ask me, we should wait a week.
Overall, it went well. → It's apparent that she's tired. (It's apparent that + 문장)
To be fair, he did warn us.
We argued, but eventually agreed. → In contrast, the old plan was cheaper. (in contrast = 그에 반해)

cards.expr: I see where you're coming from
cards.ex: I see where you're coming from, but I still disagree.

quiz.note: If you ask me = 제 생각엔. 의견을 부드럽게 꺼내는 틀.

quiz.q: ___ , he did tell us about the delay.
quiz.note: To be fair = 공정하게 말하면. 상대 편을 들어줄 때.

quiz.q: We argued for hours, but ___ we found a solution.
I ___ where you're coming from, but I still think it's risky.
quiz.note: I see where you're coming from = 상대 관점을 인정하는 최고의 쿠션.

cards.ex: I'm not gonna lie, I was a bit disappointed.
People perceive him as cold. → First impressions shape perception. (perceive A as B = A를 B로 보다)
That's a fair point — I hadn't thought of that.
Sleep is vital for recovery. → He's constantly on his phone. (vital for + 대상)
We won't settle this today — let's agree to disagree.

accept: i am not going to lie
quiz.note: I'm not gonna lie = 솔직히. 원어민 회화 단골 도입부!

quiz.q: People ___ him as arrogant, but he's actually just shy.
quiz.note: perceive A as B = A를 B로 보다. see의 격식 버전.

quiz.q: ___ — I hadn't thought about the cost.
quiz.note: That's a fair point = 반박 전에 상대를 인정하는 문장.

quiz.q: Good sleep is ___ for muscle recovery.
quiz.note: vital for + 대상 = ~에 필수적인. important보다 강해요!

quiz.q: We clearly won't settle this today — let's ___ .
quiz.note: agree to disagree = 합의 없이 평화롭게 마무리하는 표현.
